posts.name: aawood
posts.cooked:
I'm just picturing two people sat in the same room, playing the game on tablets. The Guise player is sweating.

"I have to", they say.

"Don't you da..." The other player doesn't get a chance to finish, as the first taps to play "I'm that guy". They lock eyes. There is anger there, perhaps. Resignation, certainly.

They stand, facing each other, each balancing their tablet on the palm of their right hand. No words are needed. They know what must happen. On a nod, they scream in unison, flinging their hands up and forwards, tablets first, to meet in mid-air in a shower of glass and electronics and rage.

In hindsight, they decide this was not the best play for turn 1.
